# A Fast Quantum Mechanical Algorithm for Database Search

**Authors:** Lov K. Grover  
**Year:** 1996  
**Journal:** STOC  
**DOI:** [10.1145/237814.237866](https://doi.org/10.1145/237814.237866)

## Abstract

We present a quantum algorithm for searching an unsorted database in O(sqrt(N)).
